LUTY.description:
A decently made but still crude submachine gun built in the back of the gun store as a hobby.
Poor handling, not super great.
Probably should grab whatever gun you find on the next guy.

Model submitted by Vic.
LUTY.name: LUTY

HONEY BADGER.description:
A compact Grand Federation PDW based on the AR-15 platform firing the 300 Blackout round. Moderate recoil with average performance all around.

Model submitted by Rialag & Vic.
HONEY BADGER.name: HONEY BADGER

FIVE-0.description: A highly customized subcompact PDW chambered in .50 GI built off of the AR-9 platform. Extremely high damage up close at the cost of extreme recoil and low magazine capacity.
FIVE-0.name: FIVE-0

MAX31.description:
A Grand Federation upgrade kit for the MAC-11 designed to use the 9mm Suomi KP/31's Magazines. Used as a way for the everyman to have a cheaper modern Submachine gun with existing parts.

Model submitted by Vic.
MAX31.name: MAX31

P90.description:
The P90, or Project 90, was an attempt to fulfill a desire for a standardized PDW. Though this never happened, the P90 has enjoyed constant media attention in part because of its unique design and its 5.7mm cartridge. With good damage, decently low recoil, and a very high RPM, the P90 is a solid choice for every situation.
It's O'Neill, with TWO L's!
P90.name: P90

TOMMY GUN.description:
One of the most important guns of World War II, the Thompson holds its origin in prototypes that just missed The Great War. Its great weight makes for poor mobility, but for reasonable if not bouncy recoil with great damage up close. Has a variety of magazine options.
Make him an offer he can't refuse.
TOMMY GUN.name: TOMMY GUN

BWC9.description: A sub-compact personal defense weapon with the ability to fold down for discrete storage. Based on the M17, it features fully automatic fire, great mobility, and pistol-class handling. Unfortunately, the gun's auto-sear was installed poorly and does not allow you to stop until the magazine is fully emptied. Oops!
BWC9.name: BWC9

attachmentModifiers.info: I mean... I guess? If you really want to. But why though?

X95 SMG.description: The X95 SMG is a 9x19mm conversion of the Tavor X95. Designed to ease the training requirements for soldiers, it features many of the modern features that assault rifles do whilst retaining SMG characteristics. The X95 SMG is good for nearly all ranges, with middling RPM and recoil.
X95 SMG.name: X95 SMG

G36C.description: An extremely short subcarbine variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 assault rifle. Being incredibly short, it can be used by armored vehicle crews. Trades some close range performance for better long range performance.
G36C.name: G36C

PP-19 BIZON.description:
The PP-19 Bizon is a 9mm submachine gun developed in the mid-1990s by Izhmash made famous by its huge, cylindrical magazine. The Bizon is capable of decent damage up-close, but falls off considerably at range despite its huge magazine. It also comes in both 9x19mm and 9x18mm from the factory.
Kept ya' waiting, huh?
PP-19 BIZON.name: PP-19 BIZON

UZI.description: The Uzi is an Eretz-Kedem submachine gun favored by the EKF throughout the Cold War. Known for its relative simplicity and great reliability, The Uzi packs a heavy punch for its 9x19 ammo, but suffers with bouncy recoil, somewhat reduced range performance, and poor mobility thanks to its relatively great weight.
UZI.name: UZI

COLT MARS.description: A prototype PDW designed in 1997 based on the AR-15 platform firing the unique 5.56x30 Mini Assault Rifle System (MARS) cartridge. Higher RPM and penetration with lower damage, coupled with high multipliers.
COLT MARS.name: COLT MARS
